response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_inst FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), b AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS base FROM sentimentandfundamentals) SELECT AVG(g.avg_inst) AS mean_group_avg, AVG(g.avg_inst - b.base) AS mean_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.avg_inst > b.base

assumptions.assumption: A NULL eventannotm forms its own group (SQLite GROUP BY puts NULLs together). Groups whose instownpct values are all NULL have a NULL average and are excluded by the strict comparison.
If no group exceeds the baseline, the query returns one row with NULLs.
